decisions.basis: No merge by display label and closed local AST identifier grammar
decisions.choice: Namespace symbols by exact source ID/version, scope and local symbol ID; encode canonical IDs as deterministic hashes with retained origin tuples
Compile supported static forms with lexical variable scope, arity and sort checks; partial/temporal/inductive/deontic/empirical semantics stay explicit extensions

decisions.basis: Nominal distinctness is not non-collapse proof; equal labels are not alignment
decisions.choice: Compose declarations without automatic carrier unification; only exact A05 shared-carrier records permit a union

decisions.basis: Source prose and syntax checks do not prove admitted definitions
decisions.choice: Type results remain independent of population/model/fidelity/readiness

obligation_coverage: All C01 software criteria mapped; full semantic/source readiness remains later evidence.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Malformed and ill-sorted statements rejected; equal labels do not merge identities; distinct nominal types do not prove non-collapse; serialize deterministically.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Define closed sorts, variables, predicates, relation applications, equality, Boolean connectives and supported quantifiers; namespace by exact definition/scope; explicit shared-carrier alignment; unsupported constructs stay visible.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Malformed and ill-sorted statements rejected; equal labels do not merge identities; distinct nominal types do not prove non-collapse; serialize deterministically.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
